question: What color do we mostly use to paint healthy leaves on a tree? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Most leaves on trees are a beautiful green color! 🟢
hint: It is the color of fresh grass.

question: What color do we use to paint a thick tree trunk? 🪵
explanation: Great job! Tree trunks are usually a strong brown color. 🟤
hint: It is the color of chocolate or mud.

question: What shape is the center of a big sunflower? 🌻
explanation: Super! The middle of a sunflower is perfectly round like a circle. 🟡
hint: It looks like a round wheel.

question: What do we put on a leaf to make a leaf print? 🍁
explanation: Fantastic! We put colorful paint on a leaf to stamp it on paper. 🎨
hint: We use a brush to apply this colorful liquid.

question: What shape do we draw for a tall pine tree? 🌲
explanation: Brilliant! Pine trees look like tall, pointy triangles. 🔺
hint: It has three sides and a pointy top.

question: What do we rub over a hidden leaf to see its pattern? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! We rub a crayon over paper to magically see the leaf shape! 🖍️
hint: It is made of wax and comes in many colors.

question: Which tool helps us paint a beautiful flower? 🖌️
explanation: Great job! We use a soft paintbrush to color our beautiful flowers. 🖌️
hint: It has soft bristles at the end.

question: What color is a bright and beautiful rose? 🌹
explanation: Super! Roses are often a bright, lovely red color. 🔴
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: What is the thick wooden part of a tree called? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! The thick, strong brown part is called the trunk. 🪵
hint: It holds the whole tree up.

question: Where is the best place to find real plants to draw? 🏞️
explanation: Brilliant! A garden is full of beautiful plants and flowers to draw. 🏡
hint: It is an outdoor place with grass and flowers.

question: What holds a pretty flower up high? 🌷
explanation: Awesome! The long green stem holds the flower up to the sun. 🌿
hint: It looks like a long green stick.

question: How do we draw tall grass? 🌾
explanation: Great job! Drawing simple straight lines upward makes perfect grass. 🌾
hint: They look like standing lines.

question: If we mix blue and yellow paint, what color do we make? 🎨
explanation: Super! Mixing blue and yellow magically makes green for our leaves! 🟢
hint: It makes the color of the grass.

question: What color are dry leaves that fall in autumn? 🍂
explanation: Fantastic! In autumn, leaves dry up and turn orange or brown. 🍂
hint: It is the color of soil.

question: What do we call the tiny lines on a leaf? 🍃
explanation: Brilliant! The little lines that make a pattern on a leaf are called veins. 🌿
hint: They look like a tiny net on the leaf.

question: What shape is a very simple leaf? 🌿
explanation: Awesome! An oval shape with pointy ends makes a perfect leaf. 🥚
hint: It looks like a long egg.

question: What color is a pretty lotus flower? 🪷
explanation: Great job! A lotus flower is usually a beautiful soft pink. 🌸
hint: It is a very light and sweet color.

question: What do we draw under the tree so it can stand? 🌍
explanation: Super! We draw the ground or mud so the tree has a place to grow. 🟫
hint: It is the earth we walk on.

question: What do we use to fix a mistake in our pencil drawing? 🧽
explanation: Fantastic! An eraser helps us clean up and try drawing again! 🧽
hint: It rubs away pencil marks safely.

question: When drawing a forest, what do we draw a lot of? 🌲
explanation: Brilliant! A forest is full of many tall and green trees! 🌳
hint: They have big trunks and green leaves.

question: What color is a happy sunflower petal? 🌻
explanation: Awesome! Sunflowers have bright and happy yellow petals. 🟡
hint: It is the color of the sun.

question: What part of the tree grows hidden under the mud? 🌱
explanation: Great job! Roots grow deep under the mud to drink water. 🪢
hint: They look like long strings in the soil.

question: What color is the bright sky behind our tree drawing? 🌤️
explanation: Super! The sky behind our outdoor nature drawings is a lovely blue. 🔵
hint: Look up outside during the day!

question: How do we make our green paint look lighter? 🎨
explanation: Fantastic! Mixing white into any color makes it nice and light! ⚪
hint: Add the color of milk.

question: What tool do we use to draw thin, light branches? ✏️
explanation: Brilliant! A pointy pencil is perfect for drawing very thin branches. ✏️
hint: We use it for writing in our notebooks.

question: What do we put our cut flowers in to draw them indoors? 🏺
explanation: Awesome! A vase holds water and keeps our flowers looking beautiful. 🏺
hint: It is a tall pot for flowers.

question: What color is a sweet, round apple on a tree? 🍎
explanation: Great job! Apples in our drawings look yummy when colored bright red! 🔴
hint: It is the color of a strawberry.

question: What gives bright light to the plants in our drawing? ☀️
explanation: Super! The big, bright yellow sun gives light so plants can grow. ☀️
hint: It shines warmly in the daytime sky.

question: What shape helps us draw a beautiful tulip flower? 🌷
explanation: Fantastic! A tulip flower looks just like a little cup pointing up. ☕
hint: It looks like something you drink tea from.

question: What line shape shows a leaf falling in the wind? 🍂
explanation: Brilliant! Curved and wavy lines make the leaf look like it is dancing in the air! 〰️
hint: It is a wavy, moving line.

question: What color is the mud where we plant our seeds? 🟫
explanation: Awesome! Mud and soil are a rich brown color. 🟫
hint: It is the color of a potato.

question: What can we use our hands to print with paint? ✋
explanation: Great job! Painting your hand and pressing it makes a perfect tree shape! 🌳
hint: Fingers look like tree branches.

question: What makes a cactus plant look spiky in a drawing? 🌵
explanation: Super! Drawing small, sharp lines makes the cactus look very spiky! ✏️
hint: They look like little needles.

question: Which side of a leaf do we paint for a bumpy leaf print? 🍁
explanation: Fantastic! The back side has bumpy veins that make the best prints! 🌿
hint: The side that feels rough to touch.

question: What do we draw on a branch to make the tree look full? 🌳
explanation: Brilliant! Adding lots of green leaves makes the tree look healthy and full. 🍃
hint: They are the green parts.

question: What color is a very fresh and new plant stem? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! New baby stems are always a bright, fresh green. 🟢
hint: Like the color of a frog.

question: What shape do we draw to make a big leafy bush? 🌳
explanation: Great job! A bumpy cloud shape is perfect for drawing a round bush! ☁️
hint: It looks fluffy and round in the sky.

question: How do we feel when we draw beautiful nature art? 🎨
explanation: Super! Art and nature make us feel calm, proud, and very happy! 😃
hint: It brings a big smile to your face.

question: What do we draw falling from clouds to help plants grow? 🌧️
explanation: Fantastic! Cool raindrops from clouds give plants the water they need. 💧
hint: They are drops of water.

question: What color is a sweet, ripe mango hanging on a tree? 🥭
explanation: Brilliant! Tasty, ripe mangoes are a bright, sunny yellow. 🟡
hint: The color of a banana.

question: What do we call a painting that shows outdoor nature? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! A drawing of land, trees, and sky is called a landscape! 🏞️
hint: It is a big view of the land.

question: What colorful flying bug can we draw resting on our flower? 🦋
explanation: Great job! Butterflies have beautiful wings and love to sit on flowers. 🦋
hint: It has big, colorful wings.

question: What pattern does a fern leaf have? 🌿
explanation: Super! Ferns have lots of beautiful tiny leaves lined up together. 🍃
hint: Many small green shapes.

question: What do we draw on a tree trunk to show rough bark? 🪵
explanation: Fantastic! Bumpy, wavy lines make the tree trunk look like real wood! 〰️
hint: Rough and wiggly lines.

question: If we mix red and white paint, what flower color do we get? 🎨
explanation: Brilliant! Red and white mix together to make a lovely pink for petals. 🌸
hint: The color of a lotus.

question: What tool helps us draw straight lines for a plant pot? 📏
explanation: Awesome! A ruler helps us draw perfectly straight lines easily. 📏
hint: It has numbers on it.

question: What shape do we draw for grapes hanging on a vine? 🍇
explanation: Great job! A bunch of grapes is just lots of small purple or green circles! 🟣
hint: They look like little round balls.

question: How do we show grass blowing in the strong wind? 🌾
explanation: Super! Slanting the lines makes the grass look like the wind is pushing it! 🖌️
hint: Lines that lean to one side.

question: What color do we use for a hot, glowing sun? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! We use bright yellow or orange for a warm, shining sun. 🟡
hint: The color of a lemon.

question: What is the most fun part of drawing beautiful plants? 🌸
explanation: Brilliant! Using all the beautiful colors of nature is the best part of art! 🎨
hint: Painting and coloring!
